title: grasstoucher
blurb: an off-brand wellness intervention generator: tap the tree for an unsolicited, condescending 'log off and touch grass' lecture in full tech-uncle voice, plus a grass-touched rating, a prescribed activity, and a card to share. off a thread where @hetkey.bsky.social's '35 years in IT, go stand by a tree' bit got mistaken for a bot; @joetforhire.com asked for the real thing.
